# Message threads

A conversation in a card: each message with its author, time and files, the person's own at the end in a tint, the other side's at the start - edited in place, the reply box held under the thread.

## Example

`ol class="thread"` of `thread-message`s; `data-mine` puts the person's own at the end in a tint. A message holds an [avatar](avatar.md) and `thread-body`: `thread-meta` - the name, a `time`, `thread-edited` and the message's buttons -, `thread-bubble`, which keeps its line breaks, and `thread-files` - thumbnails up to 9rem × 7rem, each with a `thread-file-remove` that shows while the message is edited. Editing is an [inline edit](inline-edit.md): the form takes the bubble's place. In a `card card-scroll` with a height the thread scrolls between the card's header and its footer, which holds the reply.

```html
<section class="card card-scroll max-h-560" aria-labelledby="thread-desk-title">
	<div class="card-header hstack flex-wrap gap-8"><h2 id="thread-desk-title">The booking page shows the wrong price</h2><span class="badge badge-subtle-warning">Open</span></div>
	<div class="card-body">
		<ol class="thread" aria-label="Messages">
			<li class="thread-message">
				<span class="avatar avatar-sm" aria-hidden="true">AR</span>
				<div class="thread-body">
					<div class="thread-meta"><span>Ananda Resort</span><time datetime="2026-11-04T09:12">09:12</time></div>
					<div class="thread-bubble">The child price on Ang Thong shows 2,500 THB.&#10;It should be 1,900 THB since Monday.</div>
					<div class="thread-files"><a href="img/lagoon.svg"><img src="img/lagoon.svg" alt="Screenshot of the price"></a></div>
				</div>
			</li>
			<li class="thread-message" data-mine>
				<span class="avatar avatar-sm" aria-hidden="true">RZ</span>
				<div class="thread-body">
					<div class="thread-meta"><span>REDZ support</span><time datetime="2026-11-04T09:30">09:30</time><span class="thread-edited">edited</span><button class="btn btn-xs btn-icon btn-text" type="button" commandfor="thread-desk-edit" command="--edit" aria-label="Edit the message"><i class="bi bi-pencil" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></div>
					<div class="thread-bubble" id="thread-desk-reply">Thank you - the price list was published before the change. It is fixed now; please check the page again.</div>
					<form class="inline-edit-form" id="thread-desk-edit" data-for="thread-desk-reply" hidden>
						<textarea class="form-control" name="text" aria-label="Message" rows="3">Thank you - the price list was published before the change. It is fixed now; please check the page again.</textarea>
						<button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" type="submit">Save</button>
						<button class="btn btn-sm" type="button" commandfor="thread-desk-edit" command="--cancel">Cancel</button>
						<div class="invalid-feedback" hidden></div>
					</form>
					<div class="thread-files"><span><img src="img/qr.svg" alt="The fixed page"><button class="btn btn-xs btn-icon thread-file-remove" type="button" aria-label="Remove the fixed page"><i class="bi bi-x-lg" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></span></div>
				</div>
			</li>
		</ol>
	</div>
	<div class="card-footer">
		<textarea class="form-control" rows="2" aria-label="Reply" placeholder="Write a reply"></textarea>
		<button class="btn btn-primary" type="button"><i class="bi bi-send" aria-hidden="true"></i>Send</button>
		<button class="btn ms-auto" type="button">Close the ticket</button>
	</div>
</section>
```

## Accessibility

- The thread is a list with a name; each message starts with its author and time in words, so the side is never told by place or tint alone.
- A file's thumbnail has the file's own `alt`; its remove button is named by the file.
- The scrolling body of a card is reached by `Tab` through its buttons and links; give it `tabindex="0"` and a name when it holds none.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/thread.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/thread.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-space-16`, `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-space-4`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-fs-12`, `--redz-text`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-border`, `--redz-radius-12`, `--redz-radius-4`, `--redz-bg`, `--redz-primary-subtle`, `--redz-radius-8`.
